title: Remove the ten zero-consumer aliases from pkg/common/re_export.go
goal: The S4 governance decision wave measured every re-export alias in backend/pkg/common/re_export.go for qualified references (common.<Sym>) across base backend and pantheon-ops/backend: ten of eighteen have zero consumers, which makes the re-export surface lie about what pkg/common provides. This packet deletes exactly those ten aliases — SetAccessTokenCookie, SetCSRFCookie, SetRefreshTokenCookie, ClearTokenCookies, ValidateRequiredProductionSecret, DefaultDevSecrets, GenerateRandomSecret, IsProductionEnv, ResolveSecret, FailWithData — and keeps the eight consumed ones. The underlying functions in pkg/common/http and pkg/common/security are untouched; consumers use them via their defining packages already.
findings: RC-043 (P2): backend/pkg/common/re_export.go re-exports 112 lines; the S4 measurement (2026-10-27, docs/reviews/GOVERNANCE_SURFACE_DECISIONS_2026-10-27.md section 1) shows 10 of 18 aliases with zero qualified references in both repositories.

in: Delete the ten zero-consumer alias declarations from backend/pkg/common/re_export.go
Re-run the per-symbol reference search before deleting and record it in evidence
Prove equivalence: go build ./... in both backend modules and the full backend test suite
Record the eight kept aliases with their consumer counts in the evidence
out: Deleting the underlying functions in pkg/common/http or pkg/common/security
Removing any of the eight consumed aliases

implementationNotes: The re-export aliases are type/const/func declarations, not wrappers: deletion cannot change behaviour, only the compile-time surface.
If the build breaks, a consumer was missed by the grep (e.g. dot-import or reflection); treat that as a finding, restore the alias, and record the false negative in evidence.
The eight kept aliases stay until a future wave finds them zero-consumer; this packet is not an invitation to shrink further.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Pure deletion of ten alias declarations; zero behaviour change.
reviewerPosture: Check exactly the ten named aliases were removed and the eight kept ones remain.
Check no underlying function moved or changed.
Check the dual-repo build and full suite ran green.

commands: cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...
export PANTHEON_TEST_DSN='<dsn>' PANTHEON_TEST_DSN_REQUIRED=true && cd backend && go test -count=1 ./...
runtimeEvidence: none; deletion of unreferenced declarations is proven by compilation of both modules and the test suite

completionChecklist: Exactly the ten zero-consumer aliases removed; the eight consumed aliases untouched
Both backend modules compile; full backend suite green
